study_identification_part.si4_title: Deep Normative Tractometry for Identifying Joint White Matter Macro- and Micro-structural Abnormalities in Alzheimer's Disease

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study clearly states its objectives: to introduce the Deep Normative Tractometry (DNT) framework for modeling joint white matter macro- and micro-structural profiles and to detect abnormalities in MCI and AD.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: In this study, we extend our NM framework and propose Deep Normative Tractometry (DNT) to jointly model the 3D geometry of WM tracts and their DTI-derived microstructures... We report along-tract microstructure and macrostructure deviations computed from DNT in mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and AD.

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: The study uses two datasets (TractoInferno for pre-training, NIMHANS for fine-tuning/testing). Citations are provided for the datasets. Sample sizes are reported (198 for TractoInferno, 123 CN for NIMHANS). However, specific eligibility criteria (inclusion/exclusion) and detailed image quality standards for the subjects selected in *this* specific study are not explicitly described in the text, relying instead on the cited references.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: The pre-training dataset was composed of 198 singleshell dMRI volumes from the publicly available TractoInferno training dataset... The dataset consists of neuroimaging data from 123 cognitively normal participants (CN)...

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: Covariates (age, sex) and scanner effects are explicitly handled. They are corrected for using linear regression on the anomaly scores.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: We then corrected for age, sex, and scanner effect using linear regression.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.location: III. METHOD B. Deep Normative Tractometry (DNT)

nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.reason: The data sources are clearly specified: TractoInferno (public, multi-site) and NIMHANS (India).
nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.supporting_text: We analyzed 3T diffusion MRI (dMRI) data in a sample of 302 participants... from the NIMHANS... cohort... The pre-training dataset was composed of 198 singleshell dMRI volumes from the publicly available TractoInferno training dataset...

nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: Preprocessing procedures (denoising, Gibbs ringing removal, distortion correction, etc.) and software (DIPY, RecoBundles) are described.
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: Preprocessing steps for all DWI volumes included: denoising using local principal component analysis [23], Gibbs ringing removal [24], [25], correction of susceptibility-induced distortion [26]... RecoBundles [7], [35] was used to segment thirty WM bundles...

nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.reason: A data partitioning strategy is used: Pre-training on TractoInferno, fine-tuning on a subset of NIMHANS CN (50 subjects), and inference on the remaining NIMHANS CN.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: Fifty CN subjects from the NIMHANS dataset... were then used to fine-tune the model... At inference time, bundle profiles from the remaining CN... were passed through the model...
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.location: III. METHOD B. Deep Normative Tractometry (DNT)

nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.reason: The model was pre-trained on an external dataset (TractoInferno) and then applied (transfer learning) to an independent cohort (NIMHANS).
nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: Leveraging a large sample size via generative pre-training, we assess DNT's generalizability using transfer learning on data from an independent cohort acquired in India.

nm8_normative_modeling_approach.reason: The statistical approach (Convolutional Variational Autoencoder) and model architecture are described in detail.
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text: The model had an asymmetric architecture, with a 4-layer encoder, a 3-layer decoder, and a latent dimension of 64... The model... was pretrained for 29,000 steps...
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.location: III. METHOD B. Deep Normative Tractometry (DNT)
